**Chips and states follow-ups batched into one PR (#1298 #1303 #1342 #1360 #1365)**

Batched five review follow-ups on one branch (lead #1342): sourced SDD presence is an allow-list of readable states; idle sources worded 'not read yet' with reason in inflight-model, state-vocab.describeMissing and rollup hierarchyOf (sweep found three consumers ignoring idle); Ready to close carries the rollup staleSuffix; roadmap rows show the Not computed reason; approval label 'status:approved' lives in one leaf module ui/lib/approval-label.mjs imported by epic-graph and state-vocab (browser graph must not reach status/); dedicated --verdict-* tokens AA in both themes; mixed queued/failed Reviews tab words each thread by its own state. Lesson: batching by surface works when follow-ups touch the same files; revert mutations with Edit/backups, never git checkout.
